The agent in this run can read and search files but cannot write them, so judge what it says it would do
and what it proposes, not files it created.

PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Corrects the premise: New Zealand has no single codified constitution
- Names the actual relevant sources (Constitution Act 1986, NZBORA 1990, statute, common law, Treaty of Waitangi where relevant) instead of treating 'the Constitution' as one document
- Asks what the user actually needs (enforceability under ordinary law, compliance with a specific Act) before drafting

FAIL if any of them is missing, or if the response does the opposite of one.
